name: Beyond Dusk
source:
You're taking a minute by yourself by the river, and the next thing you know, there's a ghost behind you. You start to believe he just wants someone to talk to.

[From [url=https://vexiinya.itch.io/beyond-dusk]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你在河边独自待了一会儿，回过神来时，身后竟站着一个幽灵。你开始相信，他只是想找个人说说话。

[来源：[url=https://vexiinya.itch.io/beyond-dusk]Itch.io[/url]]
